title.narrative: Plan International Sverige Digital Skills 4 Youth 2023-2026
Plan International Sweden Digital Skills 4 Youth 2023-2026

description.narrative: Ansökan om finansieringsstöd från Plan International Sverige för ett projekt med titeln ”Digital Skills 4 Youth Project 2023-2026”, syftar till att utforma ett program för ungdomars anställbarhet och entreprenörskap underbyggt av digitala färdigheter med olika tvärsektoriella och urban-landsbygdskopplingar.

The application for funding support by Plan International Sweden for a project titled Digital Skills 4 Youth Project 2023-2026, seeks to model a youth employability and entrepreneurship programme underpinned by digital skills with various cross-sectoral and urban-rural linkages.

The broad outcome of the proposal is to enhance sustainable, productive economic development for youth, particularly young women in a supportive environment for digital skills entrepreneurship and employment in targeted areas. The intervention has identified outcomes as key in achieving the set objective:
Outcome 1
1,680 young people, including young women in the targeted areas have strengthened skills relevant for the digital labour market. An additional 3000 young people will be reached under the virtual market intervention.
Outcome 2
Targeted areas have strengthened structures for young people's professional development including linkages with the digital labour market, especially for young women
Outcome 3
Private and governmental sectors on a national and local level have taken actions to enhance young womens economic rights and economic participation
Young women in Zimbabwe face high rates of unemployment coupled with its negative effects including lack of livelihood, and high rates of negative coping mechanisms (e.g. crime, drug abuse and risky health behaviours). There is a huge digital divide in Zimbabwe that cannot be ignored if digital skills programmes are to be truly equitable. Thus, the intervention is expected to impact young peoples digital skills, enabling their sustainable income-generation through either entrepreneurship or employment.
The project offers two streams of digital skills interventions; that is, tailored for rural and urban youth. It is envisaged that the basic digital skills stream coupled with the MakerSpace model (physical work spaces equipped to provide technical training on agro-processing that incorporates basic digital skills) will enable rural youth to perform ICT-enhanced trade through entrepreneurship or employment; whilst the intermediate/advanced digital skills stream coupled with the job market linkages will enhance urban youths employability or entrepreneurship in the digital economy.

1.4 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla män och kvinnor, i synnerhet de fattiga och de utsatta, har lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, tillgång till grundläggande tjänster, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till arv, naturresurser, lämplig ny teknik och finansiella tjänster, inklusive mikrokrediter.
4.4 - By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.

4.4 - Till 2030 väsentligen öka det antal ungdomar och vuxna som har relevanta färdigheter, däribland tekniska färdigheter och yrkeskunnande, för sysselsättning, anständigt arbete och entreprenörskap.
5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.b - Enhance the use of enabling technology, in particular information and communications technology, to promote the empowerment of women.
5.b - Öka användningen av gynnsam teknik, i synnerhet informations- och kommunikationsteknik, för att främja kvinnors egenmakt

8.3 - Främja utvecklingsinriktad politik som stöder produktiv verksamhet, skapande av anständiga arbetstillfällen, företagande, kreativitet och innovation samt uppmuntra att mikroföretag liksom små och medelstora företag växer och blir en del av den formella ekonomin, bland annat genom tillgång till finansiella tjänster.

8.3 - Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services.
